title: PermissionProfile
description: What a sandboxed execution may touch (FR-190, ADR-059). Permission modes are presets over an approval policy and one of these profiles (FR-063). Protected paths (.git, .nova, .agents, the Nova data directory, credential locations) are applied after the profile and cannot be granted here.

extends.description: Id of a profile whose entries are inherited; later entries win.

requiresSubstrate.description: Set when the profile may only run inside a VM or container substrate (always set for full).

filesystem.description: deny wins over read and write; later entries refine earlier ones.

path.description: Absolute path, ~ path, or a token: :project (session project roots), :tmp (per-session temp), :minimal (system libraries and toolchains), :home; a token may take a subpath (:project/build).

mode.description: limited allows only GET, HEAD and OPTIONS; HTTPS that cannot be inspected is blocked (FR-193).

allow.description: Host patterns; a bare * is rejected.

allowLocalBinding.description: Dev-server access to private, loopback and link-local destinations.
